$7.99 · Designed for iPad. TilePix — Pixel Art & Level Design, Anywhere! TilePix is a modern, all-in-one pixel art editor and game level designer built for indie developers and artists. Design tilesets, tilemaps, and complete game levels directly on your device — from classic top-down RPG worlds to smooth side-scrolling platformer stages. With fast performance and an intuitive, flexible workflow, TilePix lets you focus on building games, not fighting your tools. Whether you’re sketching ideas on the couch or polishing production-ready assets, TilePix adapts to your workflow with full support for touch, mouse, keyboard, and Apple Pencil. Built for Indie Game Developers:. - Export tilesets and tilemaps as clean, high-quality PNG files. - Export complete projects as ZIP files (PNG + JSON). Download TilePix today and start building your next indie masterpiece! Title: TilePix: TileSet and TileMap Creation Suite | Product Hunt
# TilePix. ## TileSet and TileMap Creation Suite. TilePix is your all-in-one mobile solution for creating pixel art, tilesets, and tilemaps. With a full suite of intuitive tools and smooth performance, it’s perfect for prototyping, designing game assets, or building multiple entire levels—from retro top-down adventures to side-scrolling platformers—right from your device at home or on the go! TilePixTileSet and TileMap Creation Suite. ### 🚀 Update V1.97 | Animation Editor! Happy to announce in the new update the addition of an animation editor view, further expanding this apps function for game design. With the revised top toolbar you can easily navigate to any of the four views with the tap of a button. To preview your animation you can press the button in the top toolbar when in tilemap mode:. it's been a while since i posted here but i'm happy to announce that TilePix now has a native macOS version! i'm hoping that TilePix will be a great addition to game developer workflows, perhaps even some level of adoption by users of the new macbook neo - thats something i am very interesting in learning how TilePix performs on that particular laptop so i would be happy to provide a promo code for 2 users. i would also like to mention the upcoming plans of an animation function so there would be a preview mode where you could see what multi-frame sprites would look like outside of the game engine post-processing, saving the user even more time! Hey all, TilePix has received a new update covering some performance fixes, but i'd like to talk more on the new feature 'Recording' which you can find by going to the settings menu and tapping the recording tab:. This will enable you to have the option of recording the entire creative process via capturing frames in the background for every action on either canvas, and you will then have a video which you can export. the slider you see at the bottom of the preview allows instant scrubbing so you can get an idea of the output result.
